memory:
Working on a 1/25 Ford F-150 model. Wants realistic off-road weathering, including subtle rust stains around wheel wells and suspension, blended with dirt effects using acrylics/weathering powders. Also seeks advice on smooth airbrushing, curved-surface decals, and authentic scale-aware details. Pre

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- The user has a new airbrush; S omits this.
- The user recently finished one model, whose identity is unknown; S omits this.
- The F-150’s underside is planned to look dirty from off-road use; S omits the underside-specific plan.
- Rust stains are planned specifically for the wheel wells and suspension components; S omits these locations.
- The user prefers smooth, even airbrushed coats; S does not state this as a preference.
- The user values patience, layering, and reference-based work; S omits these preferences.
- S adds “scale-aware” weathering and an interest in advice about decals on curved surfaces, neither of which is stated in R.
